title: Smoking Hot Axe
description: Smoking Hot Axe — The Townstons wiki
html:
Smoking Hot Axe
Piece:  Weapon
Type:  Rainbow Item
Class:  Fighter
Damage:  varies with item level

Smoking Hot Axe is a fighter rainbow item.

It is unknown how many different varieties of this particular mythic item exist. Some of the Mythic items in this series may have the same name but different attributes.

This item is soulbound.

Attributes:

The name and the look are fixed. Primaries roll as a Strength / Agility / Endurance mix. That roll is the joke ending on Mythic Suffixes.

The rest of the stats roll and do not show up in the name.

  • Resists: a pair or triple that is not fire.
  • Crit: melee crit chance. Random.
  • Health / mana: health, mana, or both. Random.

It is unknown how many different varieties exist. The same ending can still drop with different rolls underneath.
